current_interpretation: Independent large syntheses and multiple flower-specific manipulations support recurrent costs/protection around antagonist exposure, while effect magnitude remains heterogeneous

Antagonist exposure can suppress legitimate visitation or handling, but floral defence/damage need not impose a pollinator cost in every system; arrival frequency can also stay constant while pollination function changes
Mutualists and antagonists can track floral sensory/display axes across volatile, visual bract and colour modalities, although not every source estimates both roles in the same design
Consumer identity/dependency repeatedly changes response to the same floral phenotype or barrier, including dual mutualist/antagonist roles
The same visitor can change ecological function without a change in visitor identity or even arrival rate; floral defence/context can route interactions between mutualistic and antagonistic modes
One consumer taxon can reverse ecological role across its lifecycle, so mutualistic service and antagonistic cost need not belong to different taxonomic partners
Dose/expression thresholds remain a recurrent source-level Pattern
Exposure, reward state and alternative-resource context can open or close measured effects
Where/how antagonists attack changes which defence or damage pathway is expressed
Effect state changes across visitation, handling, functional foraging mode, exploitation, damage and reproductive outcome scales
Pattern conditionality is not restricted to one floral modality, defence mechanism or outcome class
Pollinator identity/guild changes the strength of signal-mediated effects

Independent physical and chemical systems show antagonist-reducing states without a simultaneously resolved pollinator penalty on the tested response; some defences preserve pollination function by routing visitor behaviour
Floral defence can be gated in space, time, body-size access or attack mode rather than expressed as one static whole-flower effect
Defence and antagonist effects can vary among populations/sites; this is retained as heterogeneity/context rather than averaged away
Expanded Pattern evidence still does not substitute for direct attraction x defence estimation
Additional Pattern modules do not identify kappa and must not be used to set it to zero
